CATALOG(1)                    CATALOG(1)

NAME                                    

catalog — concatenate and number files  

SYNOPSIS                                

catalog [-bn] [-o output] [file ...]    

DESCRIPTION                             

The catalog utility reads each file in  
turn and writes it to the standard      
output. The options are as follows:     

-b
    Number the non-blank lines.         

-o output
    Write to output instead of “standard
    output”.                            

EXAMPLES                                

                                        
 $ catalog -n notes.txt                 
                                        

EXIT STATUS                             

The catalog utility exits 0 on success, 
and >0 if an error occurs.              

SEE ALSO                                

cat(1), nl(1)
